arxiv-2107-07012.title: The Delta Invariant and Fiberwise Normalization for Families of isolated Non-Normal Singularities
arxiv-2107-07012.creator: Gert-Martin Greuel and Gerhard Pfister
arxiv-2107-07012.description: Abstract . We prove the semicontinuity of the delta invariant in a family of schemes or analytic varieties with finitely many (not necessarily reduced) isolated non-normal singularities, in particular for families of generically reduced curves. We define and use a modified delta invariant for isolated non-normal singularities of any dimension that takes care of embedded points.

arxiv-2212-07563.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Hydrocarbon Prospect Risking
arxiv-2212-07563.creator: Ahmad Mustafa and Ghassan AlRegib, Center for Energy and Geo Processing (CeGP), School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, {amustafa9, alregib}@gatech.edu
arxiv-2212-07563.description: Abstract Citation Mustafa, Ahmad, and Ghassan AlRegib. ”Explainable machine learning for hydrocarbon prospect risking.” Second International Meeting for Applied Geoscience & Energy. arxiv-2306-02900.title: Robust Fiber Orientation Distribution Function Estimation Using Deep Constrained Spherical Deconvolution for Diffusion MRI
arxiv-2306-02900.creator: Tianyuan Yao, Francois Rheault, Leon Y Cai, Vishwesh Nath, Zuhayr Asad, Nancy Newlin, Can Cui, Ruining Deng, Karthik Ramadass, Andrea Shafer, Susan Resnick, Kurt Schilling, Bennett A. Landman, Yuankai Huo
arxiv-2306-02900.description: Abstract Diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DW-MRI) is a critical imaging method for capturing and modeling tissue microarchitecture at a millimeter scale. A common practice to model the measured DW-MRI signal is via fiber orientation distribution function (fODF). This function is the essential first step for the downstream tractography and connectivity analyses.

arxiv-2403-01811.title: Enhancing Multi-Domain Automatic Short Answer Grading through an Explainable Neuro-Symbolic Pipeline
arxiv-2403-01811.creator: Felix Künnecke, Anna Filighera, Colin Leong, Tim Steuer
arxiv-2403-01811.description: Abstract Grading short answer questions automatically with interpretable reasoning behind the grading decision is a challenging goal for current transformer approaches. Justification cue detection, in combination with logical reasoners, has shown a promising direction for neuro-symbolic architectures in ASAG ( ASAG ).

arxiv-2405-04065.title: FlashBack : Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Language Modeling for Long Context Inference
arxiv-2405-04065.creator: Runheng Liu, Xingchen Xiao, Heyan Huang, Zewen Chi, Zhijing WuSchool of Computer Science and Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology {rhliu,xcxiao,hhy63,czw,zhijingwu}@bit.edu.cn
arxiv-2405-04065.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Runheng Liu, Xingchen Xiao, Heyan Huang, Zewen Chi, Zhijing WuSchool of Computer Science and Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology {rhliu,xcxiao,hhy63,czw,zhijingwu}@bit.edu.cn. Retrieval-Augmented Language Modeling (RALM) by integrating large language models (LLM) with relevant documents from an external corpus is a proven method for enabling the LLM to generate information beyond the scope of its pre-training corpus.

arxiv-2409-00410.title: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Network for Single Image Deraining
arxiv-2409-00410.creator: Shangquan Sun, Wenqi Ren, Juxiang Zhou, Jianhou Gan, Rui Wang, Xiaochun Cao
arxiv-2409-00410.description: Abstract Existing deraining Transformers employ self-attention mechanisms with fixed-range windows or along channel dimensions, limiting the exploitation of non-local receptive fields. In response to this issue, we introduce a novel dual-branch hybrid Transformer-Mamba network, denoted as TransMamba, aimed at effectively capturing long-range rain-related dependencies.

arxiv-2409-12798.title: Assessing the Zero-Shot Capabilities of LLMs for Action Evaluation in RL
arxiv-2409-12798.creator: Eduardo Pignatelli, Johan Ferret, Tim Rocktäschel, Edward Grefenstette, Davide Paglieri, Samuel Coward, Laura Toni
arxiv-2409-12798.description: Abstract The temporal credit assignment problem is a central challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL) , concerned with attributing the appropriate influence to each actions in a trajectory for their ability to achieve a goal. However, when feedback is delayed and sparse, the learning signal is poor, and action evaluation becomes harder.

arxiv-2410-20168.title: Infectious Disease Forecasting in India using LLM’s and Deep Learning
arxiv-2410-20168.creator: Chaitya Shah, Kashish Gandhi, Javal Shah, Kreena Shah, Nilesh Patil, Kiran Bhowmick
arxiv-2410-20168.description: Abstract Many uncontrollable disease outbreaks of the past exposed several vulnerabilities in the healthcare systems worldwide. While advancements in technology assisted in the rapid creation of the vaccinations, there needs to be a pressing focus on the prevention and prediction of such massive outbreaks.

arxiv-2506-20582.title: Causal Representation Learning with Observational Grouping for CXR Classification
arxiv-2506-20582.creator: Rajat Rasal, Avinash Kori, Ben Glocker
arxiv-2506-20582.description: Abstract Identifiable causal representation learning seeks to uncover the true causal relationships underlying a data generation process. In medical imaging, this presents opportunities to improve the generalisability and robustness of task-specific latent features. This work introduces the concept of grouping observations to learn identifiable representations for disease classification in chest X-rays via an end-to-end framework.

arxiv-2511-01796.creator: Misha Gromov
arxiv-2511-01796.description: Abstract When does a smooth n n -manifold X X admit an immersion to the unit N N -ball Y = B N = B N ​ ( 1 ) ⊂ ℝ N Y=B^{N}=B^{N}(1)\subset\mathbb{R}^{N} , such that the (normal) curvature of this immersion is bounded by a given constant c c ?

arxiv-2511-05473.title: Chemical Evolution and Kilonova Implications of Post-Merger Accretion Disk Winds
arxiv-2511-05473.creator: Agnieszka Janiuk ,, Joseph Saji, Gerardo Urrutia
arxiv-2511-05473.description: Abstract Context. Several gamma ray bursts have recently been associated with a kilonova emission. We study the mechanisms which could account for this effect, by means of radioactive decay of elements synthesized in accretion disk wind. Aims. We model the r-process nucleosynthesis in the accretion disk wind system, asscociated with the prompt GRB phase.

arxiv-2601-10901.title: Streaming Stochastic Submodular Maximization with On-Demand User Requests
arxiv-2601-10901.creator: Honglian Wang, Sijing Tu, Lutz Oettershagen, Aristides Gionis
arxiv-2601-10901.description: Abstract We explore a novel problem in streaming submodular maximization, inspired by the dynamics of news-recommendation platforms. We consider a setting where users can visit a news website at any time, and upon each visit, the website must display up to k k news items.

arxiv-2601-22085.title: K K -equivalence and integral cohomology Thanks: MS was partially supported by a Discovery Grant from the National Science and Engineering Research Council of Canada.
arxiv-2601-22085.creator: Matthew Satriano, Evan Sundbo
arxiv-2601-22085.description: Abstract . We introduce an integral version of the Hodge polynomial, which encodes the integral cohomology of smooth projective varieties. We prove it extends to a function which is well-defined on the Grothendieck ring of varieties and we obtain as a consequence that K K -equivalent smooth projective varieties have isomorphic integral cohomology groups. 1.

britannica-1911-chabrias.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-chabrias.description: Article 'Chabrias' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 5), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The main authorities for Chabot’s life are his MS. correspondence in the Bibliothèque Nationale, Paris, and contemporary memoirs. 1876); Martineau, “L’Amiral Chabot,” in the Positions des thèses de l’École des Chartes (1883). plos-pone-0351926.creator: Mateus Santana Ribeiro, Tiara Sousa Cabral, Gislaine Cristina de Souza Melanda, Alessandra Selbach Schnadelbach, Bianca Denise Barbosa da Silva

pmc-10606082.title: A New Approach Using BMI and FMI as Predictors of Cardio-Vascular Risk Factors among Mexican Young Adults
pmc-10606082.creator: Rocío Guadalupe Salinas-Mandujano, Rosalía Reynoso-Camacho, Luis Miguel Salgado, Minerva Ramos-Gomez, Iza F. Pérez-Ramírez, Adriana Aguilar-Galarza, Ulisses Moreno-Celis, Miriam Aracely Anaya-Loyola
pmc-10606082.description: The study aimed to identify accurate cut-off points for waist circumference (WC), body fat percentage (BF%), body mass index (BMI), fat mass index (FMI), and fat-free mass index (FFMI), and to determine their effective accuracy to predict cardiovascular risk factors (CVRFs) among Mexican young adults. A cross-sectional study was conducted among 1730 Mexican young adults.

pmc-10658395.title: A pipeline for STED super-resolution imaging and Imaris analysis of nanoscale synapse organization in mouse cortical brain slices
pmc-10658395.creator: Ezra Kruzich, Rhushikesh A. Phadke, Alison Brack, Dimitri Stroumbakis, Oriannys Infante, Alberto Cruz-Martín
pmc-10658395.description: SummaryAdvances in super-resolution imaging enable us to delve into its intricate structural and functional complexities with unprecedented detail. Here, we present a pipeline to visualize and analyze the nanoscale organization of cortical layer 1 apical dendritic spines in the mouse prefrontal cortex.

pmc-10686846.title: Research on composite fault diagnosis technology of underwater vehicle actuator with positioning error constraint
pmc-10686846.creator: Dewen Zhu, Zhiyu Zhu
pmc-10686846.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). When diagnosing the composite fault of the actuator, the characteristics of the motion force of the underwater vehicle are not analyzed, and there are diagnostic errors, resulting in the low accuracy of the diagnosis technology. In order to solve this problem and improve the operation safety of underwater vehicle actuators, this paper proposes a compound fault diagnosis technology for underwater vehicle actuators under positioning error constraints.

pmc-10777377.title: Germline gene fusions across species reveal the chromosomal instability regions and cancer susceptibility
pmc-10777377.creator: Bo-Wen Zhou, Qing-Qin Wu, David H. Mauki, Xuan Wang, Shu-Run Zhang, Ting-Ting Yin, Fang-Liang Chen, Chao Li, Yan-Hu Liu, Guo-Dong Wang, Ya-Ping Zhang
pmc-10777377.description: SummaryThe canine transmissible venereal tumor (CTVT) is a clonal cell-mediated cancer with a long evolutionary history and extensive karyotype rearrangements in its genome. However, little is known about its genetic similarity to human tumors. Here, using multi-omics data we identified 11 germline gene fusions (GGFs) in CTVT, which showed higher genetic susceptibility than others.

pmc-11454385.title: 12550 Unconventional Therapy For A Patient With Latent Autoimmune Diabetes In Adults (lada), Morbid Obesity And Disease Burden: The Use Of Insulin Lispro U- 200 Automated Insulin Delivery (aid) System
pmc-11454385.creator: Mario S Campana, Henry Zelada
pmc-11454385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: Patients with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) or LADA with obesity have been seen more often in our daily practice over the last few years. Although the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of Insulin Lispro U-200 are similar to U-100, the use of concentrated insulin delivery via an Automatic Insulin Delivery (AID) system is not approved by the FDA at the moment.

pmc-11500314.title: Incidence and variability in receipt of phenotype-desirable antimicrobial therapy for Enterobacterales bloodstream infections among hospitalized United States patients
pmc-11500314.creator: Rena C. Moon, Shawn H. MacVane, Joy David, Jacob B. Morton, Ning Rosenthal, Kimberly C. Claeys
pmc-11500314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Using a large, geographically diverse, hospital-based database in the United States (Premier PINC AI Healthcare Database), we aimed to describe the proportion and characteristics of patients receiving phenotype-desirable antimicrobial therapy (PDAT) among those hospitalized with Enterobacterales bloodstream infections.Methods:Adult patients with an admission between January 1, 2017 and June 30, 2022 with ≥1 blood culture positive for Escherichia coli, Klebsiella oxytoca, Klebsiella pneumoniae, or Proteus mirabilis and receiving an empiric antibiotic therapy on blood culture collection (BCC) Days 0 or 1 were included.

pmc-11508783.title: Genomic Characterization and Establishment of a Genetic Manipulation System for Trichoderma sp. (Harzianum Clade) LZ117
pmc-11508783.creator: Jie Yang, Cristopher Reyes Loaiciga, Hou-Ru Yue, Ya-Jing Hou, Jun Li, Cheng-Xi Li, Jing Li, Yue Zou, Shuai Zhao, Feng-Li Zhang, Xin-Qing Zhao, Willem JG Melchers
pmc-11508783.description: Trichoderma species have been reported as masters in producing cellulolytic enzymes for the biodegradation of lignocellulolytic biomass and biocontrol agents against plant pathogens and pests. In our previous study, a novel Trichoderma strain LZ117, which shows potent capability in cellulase production, was isolated.

pmc-11538021.title: Stenotrophomonas pavanii MY01 induces phosphate precipitation of Cu(II) and Zn(II) by degrading glyphosate: performance, pathway and possible genes involved
pmc-11538021.creator: Shengchen Zhao, Zitong Xu, Jihong Wang
pmc-11538021.description: Microbial bioremediation is an advanced technique for removing herbicides and heavy metals from agricultural soil. In this study, the strain Stenotrophomonas pavanii MY01 was used for its ability to degrade glyphosate, a phosphorus-containing organic compound, producing PO43− as a byproduct.

pmc-11560455.title: Critical role of non-coding RNA-mediated ferroptosis in urologic malignancies
pmc-11560455.creator: Wei Li, Liying Zheng, Peiyue Luo, Tao Chen, Jun Zou, Qi Chen, Le Cheng, Lifeng Gan, Fangtao Zhang, Biao Qian
pmc-11560455.description: Urologic malignancies, characterized by their high aggressiveness and metastatic potential, pose a significant public health challenge globally. Ferroptosis, a novel mode of cell death, typically arises from intracellular iron ion overload and the accumulation of lipid peroxides. This process has been shown to play a crucial regulatory role in various pathological conditions, particularly in cancer, including urologic cancers.

pmc-11677586.title: Determining the Effect of Varied Proportions of Cohort Administered Tulathromycin at Arrival on Nasopharyngeal Microbiota and Performance Characteristics in Yearling Steers in the First 56 Days on Feed
pmc-11677586.creator: Blaine T Johnson, Brad J White, Raghavendra G Amachawadi, Michael D Kleinhenz, Jaymelynn K Farney, Teresa D Shippy, Robert L Larson, Giuseppe Mancuso
pmc-11677586.description: Metaphylaxis or treating the entire population of cattle at arrival with an antimicrobial has been studied extensively in the cattle industry; however, little information is available on the impacts of treating only a proportion of the population with antimicrobials at arrival.

pmc-11715354.title: Plasma metabolic profiles predict future dementia and dementia subtypes: a prospective analysis of 274,160 participants
pmc-11715354.creator: Xiao‐Yu He, Yi‐Xuan Qiang, JIA YOU, Wei Cheng, Jin‐Tai Yu
pmc-11715354.description: BackgroundBlood‐based biomarkers for dementia are gaining attention due to their non‐invasive nature and feasibility in regular healthcare settings. Here, we explored the associations between 249 metabolites with all‐cause dementia (ACD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and vascular dementia (VaD) and assessed their predictive potential.MethodThis study included 274,160 participants from the UK Biobank.

pmc-12575142.title: Neck cooling provides ergogenic benefits after heat acclimation during exercise in the heat
pmc-12575142.creator: Guangxia Zhang, Guangjie Xin, Haicheng Li, Pengwei Ma, Haoyan Wang
pmc-12575142.description: BackgroundBoth heat acclimation and neck cooling have been shown to alleviate heat stress and may help maintain exercise performance in the heat. However, no previous research has been determined their combined effects on thermal perception and physiological responses during exercise in the heat.

pmc-13100929.title: Antimicrobial prescribing patterns at a South African tertiary referral hospital: Insights from three global point prevalence surveys
pmc-13100929.creator: Lucien Sher, Veshni Pillay-Fuentes Lorente, Jantjie Taljaard, Ann Versporten, Ines Pauwels, Erika Vlieghe, Heather Finlayson
pmc-13100929.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a pressing global health challenge, with sub-Saharan Africa experiencing the highest burden of AMR-related deaths. Inappropriate prescribing and rising antibiotic consumption drive AMR, while limited local data hampers antimicrobial stewardship efforts. This study analysed Global Point Prevalence Survey of Antimicrobial Consumption and Resistance (Global-PPS) data from Tygerberg Hospital to identify antimicrobial use trends and inform stewardship priorities. Standard Global-PPS methodology was employed at three distinct time points.

pmc-13412635.creator: Ângela Quinelato Oliveira, Pilar Barbosa de Meireles, Willian Cruz Ribeiro, Luciano Bernardes Leite, Pedro Forte, Alexandra Malheiro, Pedro Afonso, Anselmo Gomes de Moura, Denise Coutinho de Miranda, Luiz Otávio Guimarães-Ervilha, Mariana Machado-Neves, Antônio José Natali, Victor Neiva Lavorato

pmc-13584600.creator: Zélie Bouveret, Ludivine Pruvost, Olivier Trédan, Muriel Le Romancer, Coralie Poulard

pmc-13609282.title: Alantolactone Activates the Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase Signaling Pathway to Promote Tumor Necrosis Factor Receptor 1 Ectodomain Shedding
pmc-13609282.creator: Piimwara Yarangsee, Quy Van Vu, Yasunobu Miyake, Takao Kataoka
pmc-13609282.description: Alantolactone is a sesquiterpene lactone that possesses anticancer and anti-inflammatory properties. We previously demonstrated that several sesquiterpenes, including alantolactone, induced the ectodomain shedding of tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 (TNF-R1). In the present study, we investigated the upstream signaling pathway underlying alantolactone-induced TNF-R1 ectodomain shedding.
